neighbours.label: In Arabic text, the word piece right after the opening ت (ta-) of certain ta- verbal nouns that the tokenizer splits there: التضخم, تضامن, تضحيات, ترميم, تمويل, ترفيهية, تهدد (also طمأنينة); common ta- words kept whole (تعليم, تقرير, تطوير), the same roots without ta- (مضاعفات, يهدد) and English translations stay low. Narrow side branches: ' AND' after "AS IS" in BSD license text, and ' or' closing an English list like 'debate, arguments, polling, or'.
